notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The reference is the glTF body of the part, since no mesh of it was ever published, with its design slit closed, as the GATE paragraph of 920-001_StaticFinger.scad's header gives. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation. The revised one gives the MR128 seats and the strake slot their press fit and the column socket its slip fit, as the FITS paragraph of the header gives. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
